questions.q: What is the main purpose of a receivables activity?
options: To provide default accounting for actions that aren't the transaction or receipt itself, like adjustments and write-offs
To define the customer's credit limit
To control transaction numbering
To merge duplicate customer records
questions.explain: Receivables activities supply a default GL account (or AutoAccounting reference) for adjustments, miscellaneous cash, write-offs, and similar actions.

questions.q: Which receivables activity type must every implementation define at least one of before anyone can adjust a transaction balance?
options: Late Charges
Adjustment
Miscellaneous Cash
Bank Error
questions.explain: An Adjustment-type activity is required; without at least one defined, no adjustment can be entered against a transaction.

questions.q: What is a Miscellaneous Cash activity used for?
options: Applying a receipt to a specific invoice
Creating a new transaction type
Recording money received that is not a payment against a customer transaction, such as a rebate or interest payment
Merging two customer accounts
questions.explain: Miscellaneous receipts post directly against the activity's account rather than being applied to an invoice.

questions.q: Why are Earned Discount and Unearned Discount set up as two separate activity types?
options: Because they use different currencies
Because only one of them can ever be used
Because they apply to different customers only
So a discount taken correctly within the window and one taken after the window closes post to different accounts
questions.explain: Separating earned from unearned discount lets the business track, in the accounts themselves, whether discount terms were honored correctly.

questions.q: In the Northwind Fixtures Co. example, what happened to the $25 adjustment for a rounding difference?
options: It posted automatically to a bad-debt expense account via the Adjustment activity
It was written off using a Late Charges activity
It triggered a customer merge
It required a new transaction type to be created
questions.explain: The AR clerk selected the 'AR Adjustments – Bad Debt' Adjustment activity, which defaulted the $25 directly to its configured bad-debt expense account.
